## What landed

- **`connectors/src/connectors/dot_511.py` (+715)** — the two
  aggregate transports (I8 NEW-7): `socrata_aggregate` (bounded
  SoQL `$select … AS subject/period/count [AS discriminator]
  $group $where $order $limit/$offset`, or
  `count_function='verbatim'` on a publisher-aggregated table with
  no `$group`) and `arcgis_outstatistics` (`outStatistics` sum +
  `groupByFieldsForStatistics`, `returnGeometry=false`).
  `AggregateSpec` validated fail-closed at `sig-connectors
  validate` and at expansion: closed period-kind (`month`,
  `verbatim` — `month` rejected on outStatistics, which groups
  verbatim columns only) and count-function (`sum`, `verbatim` —
  `verbatim` rejected on ArcGIS, no statisticType) vocabularies,
  bare column identifiers only. Each group row emits a
  subject-keyed `enforcement_count` claim carrying `{period,
  count, measure, optional series}` — the DC `ENFORCEMENT_TYPE`
  discriminator splits concurrent red-light/speed series on one
  space-month. Aggregate rows mint NO geometry and NO
  per-violation/citation predicate (Part VIII).
  `geometry_kind='line'` joins the emit surface (SIG-GEO-003):
  MTA's ABLE route/programme register asserts the
  enforced-corridor shape with NO path geometry — no
  `fixed_asset_location`, no device point; a capture carrying
  published path geometry fails closed `unsupported_geometry`,
  including Socrata rows where the new
  `socrata_line_geometry_probe` surfaces any dict-valued geo
  column `socrata_point_geometry` would silently drop.
  `camera_ref_field`/`deployment_date_field` declared bindings
  pin the subject key (MTA route, DC `ENFORCEMENT_SPACE_CODE`)
  and the `installation_date` emit. Socrata `area` targets
  convert the GeoJSON polygon column to rings for the shared
  WKT+centroid path (Howard school zones).
- **`cli.py` / `field_denylist.py`** — `sig-connectors validate`
  gains the aggregate-declaration + geometry-kind/technology
  rules; the F-330 denylist binds the aggregate transports and
  inspects aggregate field declarations and explicit
  subject/date bindings.
- **`predicates.yaml` + generated registry** —
  `enforcement_count {period, count, measure}` registered
